arguments.message:
When you install the authenticator app on a new phone, the codes it generates no longer match the secret Meridian has on file, so the old 2FA codes will be rejected. To fix this, open the app on your new device and then:

1. In Meridian, go to **Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication**.
2. Choose **Reset**.
3. Follow the setup flow to scan the new QR code with your authenticator app and confirm the fresh six‑digit code.

If you can’t reach the settings page because you don’t have a working code, you can use a saved recovery code from the original enrollment to sign in and then reset the 2FA from there.

After resetting, the codes generated on your new phone will work correctly.
